Fraction mein neeche wala number roti ke kul barabar tukde ginta hai, aur upar wala number, jitne tukde humne liye. Fraction mein neeche wala number kya ginta hai, saare tukde ya liye hue?

Cake ke teeno tukde barabar hain, toh wahan har tukda ek-tihaai hai, 1/3. Pizza mein ek tukda bada hai aur do chhote. Cake ka har tukda kaunsa fraction hai?

Rangin tukda 1/8 hai. Dhyaan do, 1/8 ka 8 saare tukde ginta hai, bache hue 7 nahi. 8 tukdon wali patti mein kitne tukde bina rang ke hain?
